title: Reserve currency
description: Currencies held by monetary authorities as part of their foreign exchange reserves
extract: A reserve currency is a foreign currency that is held by governments, central banks or other monetary authorities as part of their foreign exchange reserves. The reserve currency can be used in international transactions, international investments and all aspects of the global economy. It is often considered a hard currency or safe-haven currency.
